newsitem.title: CHILE: Aur Resources explores for gold in Chile.
newsitem.headline: Aur Resources explores for gold in Chile.

text.p: Canadian mining company Aur Resources is investing $1 million this year in exploring for gold at a site in Chile's far south where it has already found traces of gold mineralization, said a company official.
"We're quite excited about it. We have found indications of gold mineralization," said David Brace, general manager of copper mine Minera Carmen de Andacollo which is controlled by Aur Resources.
"It's not a deposit... but in the next few months we hope to have more solid results."
The company is prospecting at a site covering 35,000 hectares near the town of Cohaique in the wet, cool Patagonia region, he told Reuters.
The sparsely settled area is largely unexplored for mining potential and thousands of miles from traditional mining areas in the Atacama Desert.
The property lies close to the Fachinal gold mine owned by U.S. firm Coeur d'Alene Mines Corp which started operating several years ago.
